name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer with the City Library's teen program. The page does not describe the roles.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 8 to 12. Volunteers who work with the public must pass a criminal background check.
deadline_text: The library's pages disagree. The teen hub page says registration for January 2027 opportunities opens Dec. 17 at 5 p.m. (year inferred). The teen volunteer page says to check back in January 2027 and gives no day. Fall 2026 registration is closed. Spots are first come, first served, so check both pages by Dec. 17.
how_to_apply: Fill in the teen volunteer form on the library page when it opens.
notes: Questions: 604-998-3450. The Dec 17 date comes from the Teens' community hub page. Exact roles are not listed on the page.
